config.title: Frozen GeoFMs + PCA vs the S1/S2 baseline (nested spatial CV)
config.question: Do frozen foundation-model embeddings separate irrigated from rainfed parcels better than Sentinel-1/2 features, with the same parcels, folds and classifiers?
config.changes_from: first experiment on the shared 128 px tile store with patch-aligned chips
config.answer: No frozen GeoFM beats the S1/S2 baseline (best Clay + SVM 0.910 vs 0.906, difference within the noise); Clay and Prithvi hold up better in the hardest fold.
